title: Silicon nanocantilever 500 x 50 x 15 nm: flexural modes (3D eigenfrequency, analytic)
description:
3D eigenfrequency study (solid_mechanics_3d on builtin tetrahedra, quadratic elements) of a silicon cantilever without damping: length L = 500 nm along x, width w = 50 nm along y, thickness t = 15 nm along z (library silicon: isotropic E = 165 GPa, nu = 0.22, rho = 2329 kg/m^3; a real <110> beam is ~2 % stiffer, a <100> one ~20 % softer). Clamped (fixed) on x_lo, every other face free. Uniform 5 nm cubes split into 6 tetrahedra each (3 elements over t, 10 over w, 100 along L; ~9e4 unknowns). The 5 lowest modes: out-of-plane flexure 1 (bending across t, ~82 MHz), in-plane flexure 1 (across w, ~270 MHz), out-of-plane flexure 2 (~509 MHz), then torsion 1 and out-of-plane flexure 3 near 1.4 GHz (within a few % of each other: not graded).
Analytic (Euler-Bernoulli, clamped-free): f_n = (beta_n L)^2 / (2 pi L^2) sqrt(E I / (rho A)) = (beta_n L)^2 h sqrt(E / (12 rho)) / (2 pi L^2), h = the thickness along the bending direction (t out of plane, w in plane), beta_1 L = 1.875104, beta_2 L = 4.694091 (cos(beta L) cosh(beta L) = -1): 81.58 MHz, 271.93 MHz, 511.25 MHz. The references add the first-order Timoshenko correction (shear and rotary inertia, Rayleigh quotient with the Euler-Bernoulli shape): f = f_EB (1 - J_n (1 + E / (kappa G)) h^2 / (24 L^2)), J_n = int phi'^2 / int phi^2 x L^2 = int phi'''^2 / int phi''^2 x L^2 of the clamped-free mode phi_n (J_1 = 4.6478, J_2 = 32.417), kappa = 10 (1 + nu) / (12 + 11 nu): -0.07 %, -0.75 % and -0.47 % (81.53, 269.89, 508.84 MHz).
Derived values tab: f_oop1, f_ip1, f_oop2 against the corrected references (each picked from the resonance table by a +-10 % window; tolerances 5e-3 / 1e-2 / 5e-3 are first estimates: the 3D clamp holds the Poisson contraction and the shear warping of the root cross-section, a few 1e-3 stiffer than beam theory, most for the in-plane mode, w / L = 0.1); f_oop1_vs_eb (the same mode) against the plain Euler-Bernoulli value.
Line profile tab (mid-height cut): u_z of snapshot 'resonance 1' along the centre line y = w / 2 from the clamp to the tip against the clamped-free shape phi_1(x) / 2 = (cosh(beta_1 x) - cos(beta_1 x) - sigma_1 (sinh(beta_1 x) - sin(beta_1 x))) / 2, sigma_1 = 0.734096 (peak node |u| = 1 m at the tip; the tip rotation adds ~2e-4 to the corner |u|). The thermoelastic twin is silicon_nanocantilever_ted_3d.

parameters.description: cantilever thickness along z

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size (3 cells over t, 10 over w, 100 along L; each cell 6 tetrahedra)

parameters.name: E_si
parameters.description: library silicon Young's modulus [Pa]

parameters.name: nu_si
parameters.description: library silicon Poisson ratio

parameters.name: rho_si
parameters.description: library silicon density [kg/m^3]

parameters.name: beta1
parameters.description: clamped-free beta_1 L (cos(beta L) cosh(beta L) = -1)

parameters.name: beta2
parameters.description: clamped-free beta_2 L

parameters.name: sigma1
parameters.description: mode-1 shape coefficient (cosh(beta_1 L) + cos(beta_1 L)) / (sinh(beta_1 L) + sin(beta_1 L))

parameters.name: J1
parameters.description: int phi_1'^2 / int phi_1^2 x L^2 (= int phi_1'''^2 / int phi_1''^2 x L^2) of the clamped-free mode 1

parameters.name: J2
parameters.description: the same integral ratio of mode 2

parameters.name: kappa_s
parameters.description: Timoshenko shear coefficient of a rectangular section

parameters.name: shear_rot
parameters.description: 1 + E / (kappa G): rotary inertia + shear weight of the Timoshenko correction
